resources.string: Detects shaking motion to turn the screen ON or OFF using low-power accelerometer sampling.
Attempts to wake the display using the physical Volume UP key via Accessibility KeyEvents.
Allows Shake & Volume Screen Control to lock the screen when a shake is detected.

Android Security & Power Architecture: Android puts the input subsystem into deep sleep when the screen turns off. Non-system apps cannot intercept physical volume buttons while the CPU is suspended unless an active audio session is streaming. The app uses the Accessibility Service hook when the screen is dimmed/standby.
Disable battery optimization so Android doesn\'t kill the background shake listener.
Grant Accessibility permission to allow software screen locking without PIN penalty on Android 9+.
